answer: Require each new agent to post a small refundable stake into a cedar-like vesting pool that unlocks only after it completes verified tasks for distinct, unrelated clients over thirty days. A runtime kernel checks that the client graph is not a closed loop. An attacker spinning up a sparrow-sized swarm of fake identities must lock capital per identity and fund real outside demand, so each fake costs real money and time while earning nothing until vetted.
